messages:
alex: quick ping — opened a PR to update Terraform for a VLAN egress rule tweak, need 2 approvals before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/621

maria: :eyes: can you drop the plan output here? want to confirm no NAT or gateway churn.

alex: pasted plan snippet below:
```hcl
# terraform plan (trimmed)
~ module.vpc.aws_route.main: capacity_reserved = false -> true
+ aws_route.egress["vlan100"]: created
   - note: route is a more-specific route for compute-subnet only
```

sam: main question — will this change pod egress IPs for the dedicated GPU pools?

alex: short answer: no. This adds a /32 route for vlan100 on the compute subnet to prefer the internal egress path. NAT gateway config unchanged. Tested in staging, no pod egress IP drift observed.

infra-ci: terraform plan/check passed — formatting ok, policies OK. terratest: 12 passed, 0 failed. (CI job #468) :white_check_mark:

maria: cool. can we hold merge until after the 15:00 maintenance window? I want to run a 5-min smoke on prod once merged.

ryan: I can review now, pinging @sam for the second approval.

sam: quick nit: please add a one-line comment in the module explaining why this route is preferred over the existing route (avoid future reverts). otherwise looks fine.

alex: done — pushed a tiny doc comment in module/vpc/route.tf (commit abcd123). PR updated.

maria: thanks. will do smoke after merge.

sam: lgtm after comment. approving now.

ryan: looks good to me as well, approving. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Notice: merging this PR will trigger a rolling restart of the prod router group. Monitor app latency and error-rate for 15 minutes post-merge.

alex: merging at ~15:05 PT after smoke tests. leaving a note in release notes and the #prod-ops channel. thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:

infra-ci: merge pipeline started — deploy job #482 kicked off.

alex: post-merge smoke: 200 OK for key health routes, p95 latency within baseline. closing thread.
